A bare capitalized name at an instance-argument position parsed as
EANode — an opaque operand handle — so the crown's conservative arm
could not prove two such instances distinct. Flow(1, Store) and
Flow(1, Wasi) were "not provably distinct," which made the negation
useless over exactly the nullary-constructor vocabulary the IFC
lattice is built from.

The fold runs once, at effect registration, where the env is whole and
the parser's ambiguity is resolvable: an effect name becomes
EAEffect(intern handle), a nullary constructor becomes EACon(intern
handle). Both are global identities with one namespace each, so handle
inequality IS value inequality and row equality is a word compare —
the scalar literals' rule extended to the ctor vocabulary. A
let/param-bound name stays EANode: it is a genuine runtime operand,
and a fielded constructor used bare is a function value, never a
constant.

The fold lives at registration and not in build_row_seen because the
parser calls that fold too, at parse time with a part-built env; an
env-dependent leaf there would make the row a function of parse order.

Implements SYNTAX.md exactly: lexer emits Tok(TokenKind, Span);
parser dispatches via exhaustive match on TokenKind. The C-style
string-dispatch chains are gone — every parse decision is now a
single match expression with named variant arms.

LEXER (lexer.ka):

• keyword_kind / two_char_kind / single_char_kind return
  Option<TokenKind> (Some(TFn) etc., or None for non-match).
• mk_tok(kind, sl, sc, el, ec) wraps as Tok(kind, Span(...)).
• Main lex_from loop emits typed tokens via push_tok with
  variant-direct construction (TIdent(word), TInt(parse_int(s)),
  TFloat(parse_float(s)), TString(s)).
• Doc comments (///) detected as their own variant TDocComment(text).
• Line comments (//) consumed silently as before.
• Maintains Ω.3's buffer-counter pattern for O(N) tokenization.

PARSER (parser.ka):

• Helpers replaced:
  - kind_at returns TokenKind (was String)
  - val_at removed; replaced by ident_at / int_at / float_at /
    string_at extractors (each returns the variant's payload or
    a default if the kind doesn't match)
  - at(tokens, pos, kind) uses kind_eq for variant comparison
  - expect(tokens, pos, kind) routes diagnostics through
    show_token_kind for the rendered name
  - kind_eq: full pairwise variant-equality match (69 × 69
    cases) — verbose but explicit; the substrate's exhaustiveness
    discipline applied at the predicate level

• show_token_kind(k) renders any TokenKind as its canonical
  source-form lexical string ("fn", "==", "|>", etc.) for
  diagnostic messages.

• op_prec / op_to_pipe_kind_layout / effective_prec / op_string
  rewritten as match expressions on TokenKind. The verbose
  if-else-if chains collapse to clear case enumerations.

• parse_stmt, parse_primary, parse_pat, parse_type_ty,
  parse_one_param, postfix_loop, parse_block_body,
  skip_to_stmt_end — all converted from str_eq dispatch chains
  to single match expressions over TokenKind. Variants with
  payload (TIdent(name), TInt(n), etc.) extract the value
  directly in th

Ouroboros achieves semantic closure today. lux3.wasm → lux4.wat validates,
and lux4.wasm compiles bootstrap/tests/counter.lux to valid WAT that runs
to exit 0. The Rust VM's charity is no longer load-bearing.

~4 lines of textual drift remain between lux3.wat and lux4.wat — 12
val_concat polymorphic-fallback sites in lux4 from cross-module TVar
visibility. The structural cure (DAG env + unified substitution across
modules) is carried to Arc 3 Item 5 instead of tactically patched.

Structural changes
- Delete apply_rewrite / find_rewrite inliner (~150 lines). Every effect
  op now dispatches through __ev_op_NAME. One mechanism, not two
  competing closure-capture machineries.
- Remove memory.lux duplicates that shadowed Snoc-safe versions in
  prelude.lux and eff.lux (list_contains, head, tail, starts_with,
  ends_with, contains, index_of, replace, parse_int, not, abs, max,
  min, clamp). Same-name fns are a latent bootstrap bomb: the emitter
  silently picks one and the other's callers get its semantics. The
  inliner had been masking this by inlining bodies at call sites.
- Wire count_fresh_vars (defined at pipeline.lux:102 but never called)
  as the cross-module fresh-counter bump at pipeline.lux:424. The old
  heuristic dep_n + len(mod_env)*10 under-counted on envs with nested
  TVars, causing the next module's fresh() to collide with imported
  unresolved TVars and producing val_concat drift in lux4.
- Refactor collect_free_stmt to use string_union instead of ++ on the
  bound-name set — semantically a union, bypasses polymorphic Concat
  dispatch when inference doesn't fully resolve.
- Emitter's UNRESOLVED fallback writes to stderr before emitting the
  marker. Silent dispatch to i32.const 0 is done.
- Rename codegen.lux's insert_field_at to insert_field_at_codegen to
  avoid collision with check.lux's same-named but differently structured
  function.
- Keep the VarRef emission path as plain LGlobal(name) — earlier attempt
  to always-prefix __ev_op_ for is_op

Arc 2 begins. LowIR sits between AST and WASM. No handler stack, no

Defines: LowExpr (26 variants), LowPat, LowFn, LowDef, StateMachine,

stoop/37595cc:
The browser's print dialog is a negotiation. Margins, scale and paper get
decided somewhere the press cannot see, and a zine that comes out at 94% does
not fold. A PDF is not a negotiation, and it is also the thing you can mail to
a copy shop, which is the difference between a print run of two and a print
run of fifty.

Written rather than fetched, per the zero-external-requests law. Only what
this press puts on paper is supported: two of the standard fourteen fonts,
which need no embedding, and 1-bit images, which are the only kind the intake
makes. Courier is 600/1000 for every glyph, so the body wraps exactly;
Helvetica-Bold carries a width table and headings shrink to fit rather than
spilling. Images pack eight samples to a byte and deflate through
CompressionStream, falling back to raw when it is absent.

The same imposition the screen draws, at exact coordinates: one sheet at
Letter or A4, a saddle signature as one page per printed side, and the top
row of a one-cut eight-pager rotated half a turn about its own centre.

Tear-off tabs turned out not to belong on a back cover, because tearing one
off a folded zine destroys the zine. They belong on a flyer, which is the only
object in DESIGN.md that travels between scenes, so the press writes one of
those: title, address, code, and a comb of dashed cuts with the address turned
on its side in every tab.

A hand-rolled PDF fails in three classic ways — an xref offset that misses its
object, a /Length that disagrees with its stream, and a transform that never
lands — and each makes a file some readers open and others reject. So the new
suite parses the bytes back rather than trusting them, and the content streams
stay uncompressed so it can.
